notes: The causal family score, ten-position target, per-trade risk, exits, gross cap, symbol cap and stress cap remain frozen.
Only portfolio, industry and same-day new-risk budgets change; the latter two preserve their original ratios to portfolio risk.
The 4% arm is a stress arm. With ten positions at 0.25% per-trade risk, portfolio risk above 2.5% is not expected to add capacity unless industry or same-day constraints bind.
All historical periods have already been observed; this experiment measures structural sensitivity and cannot admit a live strategy.
